name: facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanything/datasets/base/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.create_dataset_subclass: create a subclass of BaseDataset that implements _get_views to return multi-view image dicts for a custom scene dataset
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.crop_resize_images: use _crop_resize_if_necessary to downscale and crop images with depthmaps and intrinsics to a target resolution
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.sample_connected_views: use _random_walk_sampling to sample connected view indices from a scene covisibility matrix via random walk with backtracking
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.normalize_and_transform_images: configure BaseDataset with transform and data_norm_type to apply image normalization and augmentation like color jitter or grayscale
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.validate_view_types: use is_good_type to check if a numpy or torch tensor value has an acceptable dtype for dataset processing

facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.create_BatchedRandomSampler: create a BatchedRandomSampler that samples batches where each sample shares the same randomly chosen feature index from a pool
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.create_BatchedMultiFeatureRandomSampler: create a BatchedMultiFeatureRandomSampler that samples batches where each sample shares the same indices from multiple feature pools
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.create_DynamicBatchedMultiFeatureRandomS: create a DynamicBatchedMultiFeatureRandomSampler that dynamically adjusts batch size based on a feature-to-batch-size mapping for GPU memory optimization
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.use_round_by: use round_by to round a number to the nearest multiple of another number with optional rounding up
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.use_set_epoch: use set_epoch on a batched sampler to set the epoch number for reproducible shuffling across training epochs

facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.concatenate_datasets: concatenate two EasyDataset instances using the plus operator to create a CatDataset
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.multiply_dataset: multiply a dataset by an integer factor using the rmul operator to duplicate each element
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.resize_dataset: resize a dataset to a specific size using the rmatmul operator with random sampling
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.create_sampler: create a dynamic or static sampler for an EasyDataset using make_sampler with batch size and world size
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.set_epoch: set the epoch on a ResizedDataset or CatDataset to generate new random index mappings
